project_type: React/Vite SPA (frontend) + NestJS backend (v2-backend), TypeScript throughout
build_system: Vite for frontend (vite.config.ts at root), NestJS CLI for backend (v2-backend/). Frontend full build: `npm run build` (runs build:landlord, then vite build, then copy-spa-fallbacks, then validate-build). For just the SPA: `npx vite build`.
test_framework: vitest (backend: `nest build && vitest run`). No frontend unit test suite found.
verification_instructions: 1. Run `cd /home/angeli/Desktop/luxcity/proptii-r1.1a/v2-backend && npm run build` — must exit 0. 2. Run `cd /home/angeli/Desktop/luxcity/proptii-r1.1a && npx vite build` — must exit 0. Both must pass before committing.
environment_constraints: Do NOT restart any dev servers. Do not touch sseService.ts (wire format confirmed correct). Backend files (events.service.ts, communication.controller.ts, communication.service.ts) are NOT to be modified.
contribution_requirements: All changes must build cleanly. Commit on the current branch; never push.
key_patterns: SSE events flow: backend EventsService.emit() → sseService.ts addEventListener() → sseService.dispatch() → registered listeners. MessagingContext holds conversation list + unread count + online users. useMessagingPoller runs every 15s + on SSE triggers. MessageThread owns its own message list state, appends via SSE directly. Optimistic messages are rendered in a sibling div OUTSIDE MessageThread in both TenantMessages and TenantInbox.
directory_structure: src/ — tenant-facing React app. src/landlord_agent/src/ — landlord-facing React app (shared components via relative imports going up to src/). v2-backend/src/ — NestJS backend. .agents/tasks/ — planning and review artifacts.
